CheckTitle: Password recovery is governed by Okta account management policy
Description: Checks that Okta account management policy is active for recovery flows.
Risk: Legacy email-only recovery can leave password reset governed by weaker recovery behavior.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Authenticators.
2. Open the Password authenticator and edit the default rule.
3. Set Recovery authenticators access control to Authentication policy.
4. Open Security > Authentication Policies > Okta account management.
5. Add or update a recovery rule that requires strong or phishing-resistant authenticators.

Recommendation.Text: Move password recovery to Okta account management policy so recovery can require phishing-resistant authentication.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
